components.name: AccessTokenForm
components.summary: Collects an already-issued bearer token and passes it to the in-memory credential boundary.

props.name: onConnect
props.meaning: Receives the trimmed token on form submission; the component clears its input.

props.name: showLocalIdentity
props.meaning: Shows development-only local identity controls when available; defaults to true and is disabled in documentation previews.

states: Optional local synthetic identity controls in development
components.accessibility: Labels the password input, uses a submit button, and supports keyboard submission. The local identity buttons have descriptive names when available.
components.usage: Use only at the authentication boundary. Keep the token in memory; never persist it or include it in a URL.

examples.label: Empty token form
examples.description: Enter only a non-secret demonstration value here; the preview discards submitted values.

components.name: ErrorNotice
components.summary: Displays a public API failure message and an optional reload action.

props.name: error
props.meaning: Mapped through the existing public failure-message boundary.

props.name: operation
props.meaning: Selects the relevant user-facing failure wording; defaults to read.

props.name: onReload
props.meaning: Optional recovery action for stale resource state.

components.accessibility: Uses role=alert so the failure is announced; the optional reload control is a native button.
components.usage: Pass the original error to preserve stable-code mapping. Offer reload only when the current request can be refreshed.

examples.label: Stale version with reload
examples.description: A synthetic RESOURCE_VERSION_CONFLICT response; no live request is involved.
